swap PROC
    push ebp
    mov  ebp, esp
    sub  esp, 4
    push eax
    push ebx
    mov  eax, [ebp+8]
    mov  ebx, [eax]
    mov  [ebp-4], ebx
    mov  ebx, [ebp+12]
    mov  edx, [ebx]
    mov  [eax], edx
    mov  edx, [ebp-4]
    mov  [ebx], edx
    pop  ebx
    pop  eax
    mov  esp, ebp
    pop  ebp
    ret  8
swap ENDP
